subject: Newby question unable to install shinyapps

messages.author: 16c77f9e70c97cc7
messages.subject: Newby question unable to install shinyapps
parts:
Dear all,

I am new to the fantastic world of Rstudio / Shiny and I developed a small shinyApp for testing, that cobines some teaching stuff.

I am stuck at a very basic level, that probably does not depend on shiny at all: I cannot install github packages via devtools::install.

I get the following error

> devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')
Downloading github repo rstudio/shinyapps@master
Error in system(full, intern = quiet, ignore.stderr = quiet, ...) :
  error while executing command
>

Traceback() reports the following


> traceback()
13: system(full, intern = quiet, ignore.stderr = quiet, ...)
12: force(code)
11: with_envvar(env, system(full, intern = quiet, ignore.stderr = quiet,
        ...))
10: withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w) invokeRestart("muffleWarning"))
9: suppressWarnings(with_envvar(env, system(full, intern = quiet,
       ignore.stderr = quiet, ...)))
8: system_check(unzip, args, quiet = TRUE)
7: my_unzip(src, target)
6: decompress(path, outdir)
5: source_pkg(bundle, subdir = remote$subdir)
4: FUN(X[[1L]], ...)
3: vapply(remotes, install_remote, ..., FUN.VALUE = logical(1))
2: install_remotes(remotes, ...)
1: devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinyapps")

I am on linux, Opensuse 12.3 and I am running
R version 3.1.2 (2014-10-31) -- "Pumpkin Helmet"
Copyright (C) 2014 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing
Platform: x86_64-suse-linux-gnu (64-bit)

Any clues as to why my devtools installer does not work? I posted a bug opening on github/devtools with no answer so far, here: https://github.com/hadley/devtools/issues/638
Plus, I am not the only one to have this problem, it happens to other people here: https://github.com/twitter/BreakoutDetection/issues/6#issuecomment-62158074
I was thinking of a non-English setup as being the cause of the problem, but I do not see how.

Thanks!

Looking forward to be able to deploy shiny apps!

Paolo

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Newby question unable to install shinyapps
parts:
Paolo,

Did you see Winton's note in the GitHub issue. Did you have a chance to give it a try? it looks like it might be something related to no option set for unzip:

getOption('unzip')

-Andy
